title: Chiefs restructure Patrick Mahomes's contract, open up over $43 million in 2026 cap space

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chiefs restructure Patrick Mahomes's contract, open up over $43 million in 2026 cap space
sources.description: It remains to be seen if Patrick Mahomes will be helping the Chiefs as their quarterback in Week 1 of the 2026 season, but a tweak to his contract will help the team's financial outlook heading into the offseason.
